revenue.basis: UCloud Technology Co., Ltd. (688158.SH) FY2025 annual report total operating income RMB 1,699,357,006.31, filed 2026-04-09, converted at 0.14902 USD/CNY (per card's fx basis). This is whole-company revenue, not specific to the Agent Sandbox product.

note: UCloud (优刻得) is a publicly traded Chinese cloud computing company (Shanghai STAR Market, 688158.SH, listed Jan 2020 as China's first public-cloud STAR Market listing and first A-share dual-class-share company), founded 2012, HQ Shanghai, CEO Ji Xinhua. 'UCloud Agent Sandbox' / AstraFlow is one product line within its broader cloud/AI platform, explicitly stated by the vendor's own SDK docs to be based on the open-source E2B sandbox. FY2025 company-wide revenue grew ~13% YoY but the company posted a net loss (RMB -73.6M); figures are for the whole company, not the sandbox product specifically.
